senses.gloss:
पुञ्ज पुञ्ज, अस्, m. (perhaps for अपि +
युञ्ज fr. rt. युज्), a heap, lump, mass, quantity, collec-
tion, multitude; [cf. नख-पुञ्ज-फला, पुङ्ग,
पूग; Gr. πύξ perhaps an abbreviated dat. pl.,
πύκ-τη-ς, πύγ-μαχ-ο-ς, πυγ-μή, πυγ-ών, πυκ-νό-ς,
πυκ-ι-νό-ς; Lat. pug-nu-s, pug-na, pug-nā-re,
pug-io, pug-il, pugillu-s, pugillaris; Old Germ.
fû-st; Old Slav. pe-stĭ.]
—पुञ्ज-राज, अस्, m., N.
of a grammarian and author of a commentary on
the Sarasvatī-prakriyā.
—पुञ्ज-शस्, ind. in heaps.
—पुञ्जी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to heap, lay in a heap.

पुञ्जय, Nom. P. पुञ्जयति, -यितुम्, to heap,
heap up, heap together.

पुञ्जि, इस्, f. a heap, quantity, collection.
—पुञ्जि-
ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped, accumulated; (अस्), m.,
Ved. a fisherman; (according to Mahī-dhara) a
birdcatcher.

पुञ्जिक, अस्, m. hail.
—पुञ्जिक-स्थला or पुञ्-
जिका-स्थला or पुञ्जिका-स्तना, f. an allegorical N.
of an Apsaras; (scil. भूमि, ground thrown up in
digging or having such ground?).

पुञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled up, heaped, heaped to-
gether; made up into a ball, pressed or put together.
पुञ्जील पुञ्जील, अम्, n., Ved. = पिञ्जूल, q. v.
